question: What is this project / innovation vs entrepreneur talent?
answer: Two tracks: Innovation Talent (PhD + 3+ years at a well-known institution, serve China 2-3 years, no relocation required, multiple visits per year, costs covered) and Entrepreneur Talent (business plan to start in China, remote control allowed, 1-2 visits per year).

question: Can I apply individually or as a team?
answer: You may apply individually or jointly and may bring a team to China for entrepreneurship.

question: What documents are required?
answer: Doctoral degree certificate, passport/ID, CV (papers/patents/projects/awards), proof of patents and awards, and official proof of postdoctoral and current employment (official letters, contracts, appointment letters).

question: What is my role after selection?
answer: Serve as a research advisor or co-entrepreneur with the partner enterprise without affecting your current position.

question: What are my duties and rights?
answer: Support the enterprise with your expertise; receive salary support and coordination assistance.

question: Full-time, part-time, or remote?
answer: Most candidates choose remote guidance with 1-2 short visits to China per year; part-time advisory is also possible.

question: Do I need to relocate to China?
answer: No relocation required; you may visit China multiple times per year with travel costs covered; there is a two-year consideration period after selection.

question: What funding or salary is available?
answer: Selected candidates receive government project funding (RMB 3-12 million) for research plus salary from the enterprise; full-time roles may include additional housing allowance.

question: What is the application timeline?
answer: Submit materials, our PhD team matches an enterprise and prepares the application, then submits for review; the full cycle typically takes six months or more.

question: When is the submission deadline?
answer: Materials are generally submitted March-May with results announced November-December; follow the latest official notice.

question: Why should I work with your agency?
answer: Rich experience, government subsidies, startup funding support, and arrival assistance including travel and local onboarding.

question: Why do you need a video with passport?
answer: To prevent AI-forged or duplicate applications, we need a short video holding your passport and reading a commitment statement (about 3-7 minutes), submitted with your materials.

question: Can I apply through multiple agencies?
answer: The same project may only be submitted through one agency per year; duplicate submissions invalidate the application. Please make a single-application commitment.

question: How do we schedule a meeting?
answer: Zoom, Teams, or Webex are all fine; typically 15-20 minutes; we schedule at your timezone and send the link before the call.

question: Is my data confidential? Do you charge fees?
answer: Materials are kept strictly confidential and used only for the application; we never charge any fees; sensitive technical details may be redacted if you prefer.

question: Are you an official agency? Can you prove government cooperation?
answer: The talent program is confidential with no public website, but our cooperation with government offices is documented through talent-office certificates and official talent summits we can share.

answer: After selection you finalize the research topic and sign a labor contract with the enterprise; we can arrange free visits to China plus local onboarding (SIM card, bank account, submission support).

question: What is the success rate if I am not selected?
answer: This is a national-level program with roughly 10% success rate; if not selected this round you may apply again next year.

question: What additional information may we request?
answer: We may verify education, request employment proofs from each institution, awards/patent lists, invitation letters if needed, recent achievements, and passport verification. This is an operator follow-up template, not an auto-reply.
